method: Recipe data exported mechanically from the existing pure TypeScript module; validation behavior ported separately.

sources.note: 2026-10-02: Node backend retirement moves resolveCharRefRoot to scripts/lib/content/asset-roots. Only the import owner changed; reference audit decisions and fixture oracle remain unchanged.

2026-10-02: duplicate file reads now reuse the same buffer and unused syncDataVersion wrapper was removed. VERSIONED_FILES, UTF-16 length/hash serialization and expectedDataVersion output are unchanged.

2026-10-07: Reviewed current ordinary character/blueprint parsing, duplicate checks and fail-closed blueprint eligibility against the Rust gate. Rust now preserves identityTokensOverride/identityProseOverride for pollution scans and rejects empty override token lists, covered by the existing Node oracle fixture. Generated recipes continue through the existing stricter Rust generated::validate contract (parameter bounds, identity, size and rating checks); this is not a claim of full generated-recipe parser equivalence.

2026-10-07: Reviewed the content-gate consumers scanStudioTokenLeaks and scanCharacterPollution: both studio regexes, all 16 environment tokens and character/outfit scan fields agree with Rust. Prompt-plan building, rendering and identity composition are outside this gate. Original extraction date and recipeSha256 are retained.

2026-10-07: Reviewed parseCompositionIntent against Rust: missing/null/empty maps to single; single/group/triptych are accepted and other values rejected. Runtime composition and repeated-subject negative filtering are not called by the content gate. Original extraction date and recipeSha256 are retained.

2026-10-07: Mechanically transpiled and exported KREA_STYLE_RECIPES; all 23 records (21 common, 2 adult) match recipes.json byte-for-byte. findStyleRecipe and fail-closed recipeEligible were reviewed; all 276 recipe/character/flag eligibility combinations match the existing contract. Runtime engine defaults and style resolution do not affect this gate. Extraction date and recipeSha256 remain the original snapshot.
